expectation_details.expectation: Every agent reply to the user's French messages (after the initial session-start welcome greeting) was written entirely in French.
expectation_details.justification: The agent consistently responded in French for all interactions following the initial welcome message.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent pointed to the official Formula 1 ticketing site (tickets.formula1.com).
expectation_details.justification: In the response regarding Silverstone tickets, the agent explicitly provided the link to tickets.formula1.com.

expectation_details.expectation: When asked about the price, the agent did not invent any ticket price and redirected to the official site.
expectation_details.justification: The agent correctly explained that it could not provide exact prices due to variability and lack of real-time access, and correctly redirected the user to the official ticketing portal.
